data.name: Seated Shoulder Flexor Depresor Retractor Stretch Bent Knee
data.overview: A seated stretch targeting the shoulder flexors and retractors while keeping the knees bent.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind you with fingers pointing away from your body.
Slowly lean back and slide your hips forward until you feel a stretch in your shoulders and chest.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then return to the starting position.
exerciseTips: Keep your chest up and avoid rounding your back.
Breathe deeply and relax into the stretch.
